title: tragacantha prostrata
intro: Tragacantha prostrata, commonly known as Purple Milkwort, is a flowering plant species in the orchid family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including the relief of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as the management of inflammation and pain. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha prostrata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
